intro_html: Tinga is smoky, a little spicy, and tastes like you fussed over it, even though you did not. This chipotle-and-tomato chicken is high in protein and comes in cheap per serving, which is exactly what you want from a meal prep. One batch makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $3.12 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings comes in around 58g protein for about 560 calories, at roughly $2.26 a bowl.
upsell_html: Make the batch and you have a smoky, satisfying lunch that beats anything from the drive-thru. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: One can of chipotle in adobo flavors the whole batch, so you only need the one and the rest of your spice budget stays put.
Reach for the value pack chicken breast to knock the per pound cost way down.
Use store-brand diced tomatoes. They cook down into the sauce and save you real money over the fancy cans.
make_it: Set the chicken breast in the crock.
Add the chopped onion, both cans of diced tomatoes, and the chipotle in adobo.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until fork tender.
Shred the chicken and stir it back through the smoky sauce.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Fill bowls with rice, tinga chicken, broccoli, and a little cheddar on top.
